subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB367
title: Prohibits the Governor or a state officer or agency from requiring a lawful ongoing business concern to close or suspend operations during a declared state of emergency or a declared state of public health emergency.
headline: SB 367 did not pass

claims.text: SB 367 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SB 367 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
